title: Retreat at Montigo
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Brand New Construction - Media Room - Open Entertainment Layout - Convenient Beach access - Private heated resort style pool and Spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 seater Golf Cart included This brand-new luxury residence offers an elevated coastal escape designed for effortless entertaining and refined relaxation. Spanning four expansive floors, the home features an open, light-filled layout with generous living spaces, upscale finishes, and seamless flow, ideal for families or groups seeking both comfort and sophistication. Indoor amenities are thoughtfully curated, including a private media room for movie nights and gathering after a day at the beach. Outdoors, enjoy beautifully designed living areas surrounding a private, resort-style heated pool and spa, creating a serene setting for lounging, dining, and evening unwinding. Convenient beach access places the shoreline just moments away, while six adult bikes and a six-seat golf cart make exploring the area easy and enjoyable. The home’s location near Seaside allows quick access to boutique shopping, dining, and iconic 30A charm. With stylish indoor spaces, inviting outdoor living, and a prime coastal location, this newly built retreat delivers a polished, luxury vacation experience just steps from the best of the beach and Seaside. Sleeping Arrangement First Floor - King Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo Second Floor - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Soaking Tub Combo - Half Bathroom Third Floor - Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Two Queen over Queen Bunkroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo Fourth - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Full Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo
